newsitem.title: UK: Homeless beggar chosen as Calvin Klein model.
newsitem.headline: Homeless beggar chosen as Calvin Klein model.

text.p: A homeless beggar who deserted from the British Army is to join supermodel Kate Moss on the catwalk after being spotted by designer Calvin Klein.
"I'm just happy to have got off the streets and got my life together," Shaun Yates was quoted as saying by the Sun tabloid on Friday after his rags-to-riches story came true.
Yates, who had been in prison for deserting from the army, was living rough on the streets of London when his picture appeared in a book about the homeless.
Klein spotted the picture and launched a nationwide search for the 25-year-old Yates.
"I'd never really heard of Calvin Klein before and certainly never wore his aftershave or boxer shorts," said Yates as he embarked on his new career.
